geometry.bounds_reason: The formed bounding box does not prove sheet thickness, the Ø6 cutout or that the upright region came from a native bend. Volume and native sheet history/flat-pattern evidence are required.

solidcraft_only.native_expectation: SolidCraft 0.42 keeps one connected sheet-metal body with the Ø6 hole on the fixed flat, one native Fold feature and a flat pattern that recovers the original rectangular blank and cutout.
solidcraft_only.generated_relationship: Forge emits one sheet.manage_rules, one Blank sketch, one sheet.flange(type='base'), one native solid.hole and one native sheet.fold. No solid.extrude or fused-solid bend approximation is used.
solidcraft_only.saved_design_reason: No saved-design mutation is required in this first sheet-metal qualification. unit, integration and native geometry checks prove the shared rule, native feature history and formed geometry; a post-build flat-pattern inspection proves recoverability of the developed blank.
